title: Turkish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and aromatic Turkish-inspired lamb stew, perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.notes: shoulder or shank cuts work well

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.notes: ground cumin and coriander work well

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, awesome, and aromatic. Cook for 1 minute.
Add stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley or cilantro if desired.
